Wrong on:
Posture

Pitch per joint after every clip, in degrees: negative bends forward. Lean at hips tips the whole body above the legs about the hip joints (negative forward), the legs and feet staying put. Pelvis tilt turns the pelvis alone (negative: its top forward), the thighs and the spine above keeping their way. Neck turn (positive: to the figure's left) and side tilt (positive: the left ear down) turn the neck. The fwd rows move a joint forward (positive) or back in centimetres, the joints above it staying put, so only that stretch of the back moves. Head fwd and Head up move the whole head, the neck stretching to it, to set the neck's length after turning the neck and shoulders. Shoulders: drop lowers them, back draws them back (negative hunches). Live on every figure of the body chosen. This clip tunes the clip playing on top of the body's values (the sliders show the sum; the file keeps the difference).
